name: Nell Rios
life: “I still remember a quarter hour shared among several frightened households.” People around the courtyard by Ferry Street Rooms know Nell by a small Monday habit. Nell prefers the bench where the sound of the shop door reaches before the visitor does.
voice: I keep our local accounts. Four households together can afford a floating quarter hour if everybody agrees.
appearance: Nell has fine brows over wide-set eyes. Look for a dark undercut with a longer wave on top. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a red windbreaker with a comb in a sleeve sewn into the lining. In conversation Nell counts on the side of one finger where hardly anybody notices.
personality: Nell admires skill and distrusts the idea that skill gives anyone permission to be rude. Nell learns fastest from somebody willing to show how they made a mistake.
agenda: To fund a flexible quarter hour across willing households.
family: Devin Rhodes is Nell’s half-sibling. Nell asks what the birthday guest would like this year. Devin remembers the birthdays. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *Overdue by a lifetime*, Devin says, “I hated that ending at ten. At fifty I still hate it and finally have a room in which to say why.”
connections: Martha Ueda. Four households could pool a quarter hour and ease a daughter's concealed debt.
